item.title: Minnesota weather: Low visibility and slick travel conditions in Twin Cities Wednesday night
item.description: A winter storm dumped heavy snow across much of Minnesota on Wednesday, making travel difficult in the Twin Cities and Greater Minnesota. Snow in northern Minnesota led to white-out conditions along Lake Superior, and blowing snow in southwestern Minnesota led to no travel advisories, which are now lifted. Widespread snowfall hit most of northern Minnesota on Wednesday. The area was under a winter storm warning, while the stretch of the arrowhead along Lake Superior was under a blizzard warning.

item.title: U2 releases tribute song to honor Renee Good
item.description: U2 has released a new song honoring Renee Good, who was killed in Minneapolis by an Immigrations and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent in January. item.title: MN winter weather whiplash: 409 crashes in Minnesota storm
item.description: A sudden winter storm took Minnesota drivers by surprise, leading to chaotic road conditions and numerous accidents.Winter storm impacts Minnesota roadsThe storm began as rain, turning roads icy and leading to dangerous driving conditions. The State Patrol reported 409 crashes, 25 injury crashes, and 316 vehicles off the road. item.title: Breaking the ice: A Minneapolis man's mission to keep the Twin Cities on solid ground
item.description: A Minneapolis man is on a mission to keep the Twin Cities safe on the ice.Ice safety advocateSteven Glasford, who moved to Minneapolis from Boston, has embraced the city's outdoor lifestyle. "I moved here from Boston and I kind of fell in love with the city's park systems," said Glasford.
